name: BEND SURGERY CENTER

fr.elements: Main Building; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Internal Drive Aisle; Walkway; Landscaped Area; Street Frontage; Access Road; Dumpster Enclosure
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Large Parking Area; Limited Rear Access
fr.recommendations:
• Mark all access points with visible signage identifying each entry as a numbered or labeled access point to help responders communicate locations during an incident.

• Mark the rear of the building with a clearly visible address or unit identifier to help responders locate the structure from limited rear access routes.

• Keep the internal drive aisle clear of parked vehicles and obstacles to maintain a continuous path for emergency vehicles around the building.

• Post the primary access road entrance with reflective address signage visible from the street in both directions.

• Keep the dumpster enclosure and surrounding area clear of overflow debris that could block emergency vehicle movement through adjacent drive aisles.

• Mark the boundary of the large parking area with directional signage guiding responders to the building entrance and any secondary access points.

wildfire.conditions: Large Paved Area; Scattered Shrubs; Landscaped Island; Open Paved Area; Grass Cover; Scattered Trees; Vegetation Near Building; Adequate Vegetation Separation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs that are growing close to the building walls where vegetation is visible near the structure.
• Remove dead or dry grass from areas where grass cover meets the building perimeter.
• Thin shrubs in the landscaped island to reduce the concentration of plant material in that area.
• Keep the large paved area and open paved surfaces clear of any vegetation encroachment along edges and joints.
• Maintain the existing open paved areas that currently separate vegetation from the building.
